# Locally served UI dependencies

These are copies of the versions already referenced by the application before the workspace refresh. Their copyright/license banners are retained.

- Bootstrap 5.3.0: `bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`. MIT license. Downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/`.
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0: `fontawesome/css/all.min.css` and three WOFF2 font files. Font Awesome Free uses CC BY 4.0 for icons, SIL OFL 1.1 for fonts, and MIT for code, as identified in the CSS banner. Downloaded from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/`.

No remote font or CDN connection is required for the shared application interface. Browser/system fonts provide the fallback typography.
